title: Knowledge Through Connection Rather Than Accumulation

content.body: The core premise of MemTrace: knowledge does not need to reside in massive documents. Each node captures only a single idea, and its value stems from the network of connections between nodes. Nodes themselves are lightweight, but together through relationships they form a vast knowledge base. The scale of a knowledge base is not determined by the size of individual nodes, but by the density and quality of relationships between nodes.
